result.subject: Request for a 30-Minute Lab Tour During Student Expedition
result.body:
Your recent work on micro-robotics and magnetic actuation at Shanghai Jiao Tong University has significantly advanced the field. We are a small group of engineering students visiting Shanghai to explore cutting-edge research in robotics and materials science. We write to seek your guidance and insight during our visit.

We are particularly interested in your research on magnetic actuation and its applications in micro-robotics. Our group hopes to understand the challenges and innovations in designing responsive, autonomous microsystems. This knowledge will greatly enhance our project on bio-inspired robotic systems.

We would be honored to request a 30-minute lab tour during our visit. We are happy to adapt to your schedule and are flexible with the timing. Thank you for considering our request.
